channel.title: ReviewRemoval Research and Guides
channel.description: Original review moderation research and practical reporting guides for Canadian businesses.

item.title: Google review removal for optometry clinics
item.description: Assess misleading Google reviews about your optometry clinic, keep patient information private and learn what to send ReviewRemoval for a free assessment.

item.title: Google review removal for physiotherapy clinics
item.description: See how misleading Google reviews can cost Canadian physio clinics new bookings, which reviews qualify for removal, and what two extra visits could be worth.

item.title: Google review removal for real estate agents and brokerages
item.description: A Google review names the wrong agent or brokerage. See how Canadian real estate teams can document the mix-up and request a free assessment.

item.title: Google review removal for renovation contractors
item.description: Know what to save when a Google review blames your renovation company for another trade’s work. Get a free assessment from ReviewRemoval in Canada.

item.title: Google reviews without text: a 516,281-record audit
item.description: In a historical Alaska archive, 43.2% of cleaned Google review records lacked text. See how a text-only filter changes the sample and download the data.

item.title: Does Google review removal improve rankings?
item.description: See why a higher star rating and better Maps visibility are different outcomes. Explore data and charts from 1,571 listings across six U.S. metros.

item.title: Google review removal times: a 2026 data audit
item.description: An audit of 2,800 published Google Maps legal-notice cells shows what median processing times can tell us. See charts and download the data.

item.title: Google review removal appeals: the 2026 data
item.description: Compare Google Maps reversal rates by appeal direction. Explore 74 source cells, three charts and open EU-focused data, with limits for Canadian businesses.

item.title: Google Review Risk Scores: A Denominator Study
item.description: See why deleted reviews can’t reveal a Google profile’s overall risk. Explore six mathematical models, three charts and downloadable research data.

item.title: Google Review Removal Statistics: 2024–2025 Audit
item.description: Compare five Google review removal reasons using the same denominator. Download the corrected 2024–2025 dataset and inspect 13 original comparisons.

item.title: Google reviews not showing: check the right problem
item.description: Check whether a Google review is delayed, posted on another listing or removed. Learn which details to verify and when to check a report’s status.

item.title: How to report a Google review and check an appeal
item.description: Check a Google review report, learn what “appeal eligible” means and prepare a one-time appeal. Includes a case tracker for multiple reviews.

item.title: Google review removal and rating changes: a 1,625-scenario study
item.description: Could removing a one-star Google review change your rating? Calculate a possible range and explore 1,625 modelled scenarios, charts and open data.

item.title: Google Reviews and Canadian tourism SMEs: what the 2023 data shows
item.description: Google Reviews activity reached 63.8% for tourism SMEs versus 47.0% across industries in the 2023 data. View the ISED source, chart and CSV.

item.title: Google Maps review moderation, 2019–2025: seven years of published figures
item.description: Compare seven years of Google Maps review moderation data. See original charts, download the CSV and learn how Google counts blocked or removed reviews.

item.title: ReviewRemoval Google review removal FAQ
item.description: See what to send, what the free assessment covers and when ReviewRemoval’s CAD $50 upfront and $125 success fees apply.

item.title: What evidence helps when you report a Google review?
item.description: Prepare evidence for a Google review report or appeal. Use a five-step checklist and see what records help support a specific policy concern.
